Elite Spears
(Normal Spears | Exceptional Spears)

Spears, tridents, and the other longer, two-handed stabbing weapons are designed for attacking enemies from a long distance away. Amazons are renowned for their skill with spears.

Spear speeds are listed by Class: Ama = Amazon, Asn = Assassin, B = Barbarian, D = Druid, N = Necromancer, P = Paladin, S = Sorceress.
